description.p: A native desktop client for your Navidrome music library, written in Rust.
Browse albums and play original audio locally with transport controls, an equalizer and spectrum display. This is an early migration build.
Rate songs and albums with shared account values and retry for failed saves.
Rediscover albums by year, server listening history or a stable random selection.
Browse all songs and explore genres with paged song lists and album grids.
Return to recent albums, playlists and artists from a native Home page.
Select lyric lines and save or copy a local image with optional cover art.
Optionally fill missing lyrics from LRCLIB and follow genuine word timestamps.
Read server lyrics, follow timed lines and click a verse to seek without losing your pause state.
Restore the local queue and playback position after restart, paused until you choose to play.
Shuffle remaining collection tracks and repeat a song or collection without losing your place.
Play songs and albums next, add them to the queue, and rearrange upcoming occurrences.
Create and edit playlists, add selected songs to several playlists, and safely retry failed changes.
Browse and play the playlists available on your Navidrome account.
First Navifast release candidate, with Navidrome sign-in, album browsing, original-audio playback, an equalizer, and buffered streaming.
